description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans grain directory partition functionality, verifying behaviors such as handling dead silos, preventing duplicate activations, conditional updates, and lookup filtering within the grain directory implementation.

classes.name: GrainDirectoryPartitionTests
classes.description: Unit tests verifying the behavior of the grain directory partition, including handling of dead silos, concurrency control, and lookup correctness.

classes.name: MockSiloStatusOracle
classes.description: A mock implementation of the ISiloStatusOracle interface used for testing silo status behaviors.

methods.name: OverrideDeadEntryTest
methods.description: Tests that directory entries pointing to dead silos can be overridden to allow recovery.

methods.name: DoNotInsertInvalidEntryTest
methods.description: Verifies that the directory rejects registration attempts for silos marked as dead.

methods.name: DoNotOverrideValidEntryTest
methods.description: Ensures that valid entries are not overridden by new activation attempts, maintaining the single activation guarantee.

methods.name: OverrideValidEntryIfMatchesTest
methods.description: Tests conditional updates where the previous address matches, allowing safe handoff of activations.

methods.name: DoNotOverrideValidEntryIfNoMatchTest
methods.description: Verifies that conditional updates fail when the previous address does not match the current directory entry.

methods.name: DoNotReturnInvalidEntryTest
methods.description: Ensures that lookups do not return addresses pointing to dead silos, filtering out stale entries.
